statement: The University of Florida blueberry breeding programme publishes measured values for Patrecia of firmness of 212 to 265 g/mm with an average of 232, average berry weight of 3.0 g, average diameter of 19.9 mm and average soluble solids of 10.5 degrees Brix. The firmness figures use the programme's own g/mm compression index and are not directly comparable with firmness figures produced by other methods.
